title: Electric vs petrol car
subject: car
scope: Buying and running a new Category A car in Singapore for the 10-year COE: the price with COE, upfront extras, then fuel or charging and road tax, insurance and servicing each year. Resale and PARF rebate are not deducted.
limits: COE moves every fortnight (S$132,004 for Cat A on 21 Oct 2026), so ask dealers for today's price. The petrol price is an estimate built from COE, OMV and ARF, not a dealer quote.

items.name: BYD Atto 1
items.notes: List price with COE, Sep 2026. Charging: about 14 kWh/100 km, 15,000 km a year, mostly home charging at about S$0.31 to 0.38 per kWh. Upfront: home charger from about S$3,500. Upkeep: road tax about 850 (kW-based plus S$700 flat), insurance about 2,300, servicing about 500.

items.name: Deepal S05
items.notes: Recent listing price with COE, Sep 2026. Running costs estimated: about 16 kWh/100 km; road tax near the 110 kW Cat A figure of S$952 plus extras.

items.name: Petrol small car
items.notes: Built-up estimate: COE 132,004 + OMV about 28,000 + ARF about 31,200 + dealer margin. No current petrol Cat A price was found. Fuel: 6.5 L/100 km, 15,000 km a year at S$3.37 per litre (Jul 2026). Upkeep: road tax about 1,000, insurance about 1,800, servicing about 1,000.

builtBy: Built by hand with Claude in a chat on 25 Oct 2026, before the research agent existed.
